work.title: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

data.text: Say: He is Allah, the One!

work.title: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

data.text: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!

work.title: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

data.text: He begetteth not nor was begotten.

work.title: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

data.text: And there is none comparable unto Him.
